def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep_r=[len(set(g[i]))==1 for i in range(h)]
    sep_c=[len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 for j in range(w)]
    cr=[i for i in range(h) if not sep_r[i]]; cc=[j for j in range(w) if not sep_c[j]]
    block=[[g[i][j] for j in cc] for i in cr]
    ch,cw=len(cr),len(cc)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in cr:
        bi=(i-cr[0])%ch  # wrong; need position in band; but bands of content rows are contiguous between sep rows
    # band position: distance from last separator row above (or start)
    def pos(idx,flags):
        p=0
        while idx-p>=0 and not flags[idx-p]: p+=1
        return p-0 if idx-p<0 else p-1  # messy
    def bpos(idx,flags):
        k=idx
        while k>=0 and not flags[k]: k-=1
        return idx-k-1
    for i in range(h):
        if sep_r[i]: continue
        bi=bpos(i,sep_r)%ch
        for j in range(w):
            if sep_c[j]: continue
            bj=bpos(j,sep_c)%cw
            out[i][j]=block[bi][bj]
    return out

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    uni_r=[len(set(g[i]))==1 for i in range(h)]
    uni_c=[len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 for j in range(w)]
    cr=[i for i in range(h) if not uni_r[i]]; cc=[j for j in range(w) if not uni_c[j]]
    block=[[g[i][j] for j in cc] for i in cr]
    bvals={v for row in block for v in row}
    sep_r=[uni_r[i] and g[i][0] not in bvals for i in range(h)]
    sep_c=[uni_c[j] and g[0][j] not in bvals for j in range(w)]
    ch,cw=len(cr),len(cc)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    def band_start(idx,flags):
        k=idx
        while k>=0 and not flags[k]: k-=1
        return k+1
    for i in range(h):
        if sep_r[i]: continue
        bi=(i-band_start(i,sep_r))%ch
        for j in range(w):
            if sep_c[j]: continue
            bj=(j-band_start(j,sep_c))%cw
            out[i][j]=block[bi][bj]
    return out
